verdict.rationale: A data orchestration platform could reasonably publish a machine-readable API spec, so the axis applies. The pack has no evidence of one: probes for OpenAPI/Swagger paths all returned 404. The llms.txt file and the MCP server are documentation and agent-access features, not a downloadable API spec, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
